citations.assessment: The exact Yerushalmi unit gives a solo Yehoshua transmission and later names Berekhiah, Abba bar Kahana and Yehoshua together in the name of Pinchas. Preserve Heilprin’s listing and note the primary grouping.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: The Yerushalmi gives a solo transmission and a later three-person transmission through Yehoshua, Berekhiah and Abba bar Kahana, in Pinchas’s name. Preserve the received grouping.
